data_ordering: Action-current formulas and their exploratory derivation were already inspected before predata was committed. This preregistration is a reproducibility freeze, NOT prospective blind confirmation.
aim: Derive full scalar shift current from original combined GE06 analytic memory-off AeST action and GE05 quadratic normalized bath action in frozen 1+1 longitudinal plane-symmetric sector, verify linearized FLRW time/space currents and exact beta scalar Euler bath source, and determine whether the CLASS effective-fluid variable map is fully certified.

original_normalizations.action_GE05: L_bath=eta*N*L*R²/4*[Aq²-(omega*q-sqrt(w)*X)²] for normalized q, one positive mode
original_normalizations.invariants: sigma=(phi_t-b*phi_x)/N; Q=cosh(u)*sigma+sinh(u)*phi_x/L; X=sinh(u)*sigma+cosh(u)*phi_x/L; E=cosh(u)[(u_t-b*u_x)/N+N_x/(N L)]+sinh(u)[(L_t-b L_x-L b_x)/(N L)+u_x/L]; Aq=cosh(u)(q_t-b q_x)/N+sinh(u)q_x/L

expected_general_off_shell.reason: The combined action depends on phi only through phi_t and phi_x; scalar shift symmetry exactly enforces the divergence form, off shell, in this reduced sector.

flrw_first_order.scalar_mode_projection: If B_X1=(ik/a)*Bchi, then bath scalar Euler residual E_phi,bath=-ik bath_dJx=-eta*a*k²*Bchi/2, matching a³ times LW16 raw E_phi=-eta*(k/a)²*Bchi/2.

limitations: This derives COMPLETE scalar Euler current of the frozen REDUCED analytic GE06+GE05 1+1 action only. GR does not depend on phi. Numerical q is normalized, its physical eta scaling is fixed; do not conflate GE05 bare q with arbitrary finite eta.
